comment: HH_260906 - Freeze a single smallest camera-covered DB member before reading its payload; no extraction, unsafe deserialization or training.
selection_rule: Minimum (uncompressed file_size, exact member name) among the seven existing camera-group-0 covered logs; not selected by driving outcome.
